34:t_002:10.en:
$$マリ$$
「Doesn't look like we can afford to talk like that in this situation.」

34:t_002:12.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Currently preparing to boot it with the Dummy System.」

34:t_002:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...The target hasn't sortied? Then we'll simply flush it out.」

34:t_002:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「All units, begin the attack! Destroy those two artificial humans, and destroy the entire facility too!」

34:t_002:16.en:
$$マリ$$
「So these are the aliens everyone's talking about... Word is they've been doing whatever they like all over the place, but we won't let them do it here...!」

34:t_003:0.en:
$$シゲル$$
「Reading directly overhead! $$サイデリアル$$'s jamming delayed our detection!」

34:t_003:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「It's entered the $$ジオフロント$$! This is...!」

34:t_005:0.en:
$$シゲル$$
「Direct hit on Headquarters as well!」

34:t_005:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「Its attack power exceeds any Angel we've seen so far!」

34:t_005:2.en:
$$冬月$$
「The strongest of the Rejection type, $$第１０の使徒$$... Its destructive power is beyond what I expected...」

34:t_005:4.en:
$$マコト$$
「The Angel seems to be targeting not just the EVAs, but $$サイデリアル$$ as well!」

34:t_005:5.en:
$$ミサト$$
「That should buy us a little time.」

34:t_005:6.en:
$$シゲル$$
「We're going to stop $$サイデリアル$$ with an Angel?」

34:t_005:7.en:
$$ミサト$$
「The other way around. We'll have $$サイデリアル$$ act as a breakwater to stop the Angel.」

34:t_005:8.en:
$$ミサト$$
「If the Angel reaches $$セントラルドグマ$$, the world ends... We have to stop that at all costs...」

34:t_005:9.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「General $$ダバラーン$$...! That monster is...」

34:t_005:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Heh... This planet is quite exciting, isn't it...」

34:t_005:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That monster is a target too! We'll present its carcass to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ as a souvenir as well!」

34:t_005:13.en:
$$マリ$$
「Guests are pouring in, huh. Well, well, this is a pickle.」

34:t_005:15.en:
$$マリ$$
「Wanna try calling Puppy for help?」

34:t_005:17.en:
$$マリ$$
「Yeah, yeah, I'll quit with the extra talk and focus on fighting.」

34:t_009:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「The core unit is rejecting the Dummy! It's no good! EVA Unit-01 won't boot!」

34:t_009:2.en:
$$冬月$$
「It won't even accept the Dummy...」

34:t_009:3.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$$冬月$$, I'm leaving things to you... for a while.」

34:t_010:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「...We can't win like this... All right, let's give it a try...」

34:t_010:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Let's see the power of an EVA that has thrown humanity away.」

34:t_010:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Mode inversion... Secret code... The Beast!」

34:t_011:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Ngh... uu... uuu...! Hang in there, $$ＥＶＡ２号機$$... I'll... hang in there too...!」

34:t_011:2.en:
$$マコト$$
「The EVA has a function like that...!」

34:t_011:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「The limiters have been removed! Everything is out of spec!」

34:t_011:4.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Monitoring inside the plug is impossible! But...!」

34:t_011:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Probably a negative plug depth... She doesn't even hesitate to enter the contaminated zone.」

34:t_011:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「You have... to throw... yourself... away... to find... a way... Huh?!!」

34:t_012:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Not yet! Not until I've broken through the whole A.T. Field!」

34:t_014:1.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The EVA's second beast form... Even after throwing humanity away and specializing it for combat, it still can't win... Is this our limit...?」

34:t_016:4.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「A.T. Field... full power! Until $$碇$$... gets here... I'll do it...! That's why!」

34:t_016:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「We won't let you hog all the glory!」

34:t_017:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「I've beaten this borrowed Unit-02 up this badly...! If I can't stop it with this, I'll have no face to show its real pilot!」

34:t_017:2.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Fool...! Have you forgotten we're here!」

34:t_017:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「All units, attack! Bury that monster and the artificial humans!」

34:t_018:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'm... fine, I said...! This is nothing!」

34:t_018:2.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「If we... break the A.T. Field... the enemy's... attacks... will hit the Angel...! Then...!」

34:t_018:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Come on, take your shots, aliens! That won't take down the Angel or the EVAs!!」

34:t_019:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「No good...! Its regeneration is outpacing the damage!」

セントラルドグマ.evidence: Central Dogma, the deepest level of NERV HQ beneath the Geofront (Evangelion); standard English rendering in Evangelion translations

kept_omissions: 34:t_016:4: trailing 'dakara!' left unfinished ('That's why!') - what Rei is asking (Mari / Unit-00 / herself) is not stated
34:t_002:14: 'the target' kept generic (attack target is NERV/Geofront; Dabalan does not name it)
uncertain: Rei speaker/name token: chose pt394 (female Rei), the Rei who calls Shinji 'Ikari' ($$碇$$ as in Jigoku)
ワンコ君 (34:t_005:15) rendered 'Puppy' as Mari's nickname for Shinji; not checked against other 2005 slices
34:t_011:7 is Mari's broken-up proverb 身を捨ててこそ浮かぶ瀬もあれ (pun on あれ / 'huh?'); rendered loosely
34:t_006:0 / 34:t_019:0 やったの: 'Is it finished?' (did we kill it), subject inferred
34:t_005:13 千客万来: 'Guests are pouring in' is a loose idiom rendering
34:t_002:10 replies to Misato's 'I'd like to crush the battleship early'; 'talk like that' inferred
第１０の使徒 in Fuyutsuki's line placed mid-sentence so the token's lowercase 'the' reads fine
セントラルドグマ proposed as a new token (Central Dogma)
